name: ButtonGroup
description: Lays out related buttons in a row with one shared gap and alignment.

wrap.description: Allow buttons to wrap to next line

when: Confirm/cancel pairs at the end of a form
whenNot: Navigation links — use a nav element
guidelines: Two to four buttons; more belongs in a Menu
Pass role, aria-label, id and data-* straight through to ButtonGroup
accessibility: Add role="group" plus aria-label when the set needs a name
Order buttons the way they read, not the way they look

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Confirming action sits last in the row.

examples.name: Spacing
examples.description: Four gap steps, from touching to airy.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="column" gap="md">
  <ButtonGroup gap="none">
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">None</Button>
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Gap</Button>
  </ButtonGroup>
  <ButtonGroup gap="xs">
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">XS</Button>
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Gap</Button>
  </ButtonGroup>
  <ButtonGroup gap="sm">
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">SM</Button>
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Gap</Button>
  </ButtonGroup>
  <ButtonGroup gap="md">
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">MD</Button>
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Gap</Button>
  </ButtonGroup>
</Stack>

examples.name: Alignment
examples.description: Pins the row to the left, centre, or right of its container.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="column" gap="md">
  <ButtonGroup align="start">
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Start</Button>
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Aligned</Button>
  </ButtonGroup>
  <ButtonGroup align="center">
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Center</Button>
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Aligned</Button>
  </ButtonGroup>
  <ButtonGroup align="end">
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">End</Button>
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Aligned</Button>
  </ButtonGroup>
</Stack>

examples.name: Wrapping
examples.description: Buttons drop to a second line instead of overflowing.
examples.code:
<ButtonGroup wrap>
  <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Approve</Button>
  <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Request changes</Button>
  <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Reassign reviewer</Button>
  <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Move to backlog</Button>
  <Button variant="secondary" size="sm">Archive</Button>
</ButtonGroup>

examples.name: Form Actions
examples.description: Right-aligned pair, named for screen readers.
examples.code:
<ButtonGroup align="end" role="group" aria-label="Form actions">
  <Button variant="ghost">Cancel</Button>
  <Button variant="primary">Submit</Button>
</ButtonGroup>

relations.note: Use Stack for more general layout needs

propsSummary: Pass-through DOM props supported on root (id, role, aria-*, data-*, handlers)
